links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease readability of chatbot responses to RA exercise questions
links.effect: Mean Flesch Reading Ease scores were 50.20 for DeepSeek-R1, 46.66 for ChatGPT-5, and 37.33 for Gemini 2.5; all responses classified as difficult to read.
links.quote: Mean readability scores were 50.20 for DeepSeek-R1, 46.66 for ChatGPT-5, and 37.33 for Gemini 2.5, indicating that all responses were classified as difficult to read.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy, quality, and readability of three commercial LLMs responding to rheumatoid arthritis exercise questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
